notes:
- This release is for Windows. macOS and Linux stay on 1.5.1 for now; their update follows
- A computer connected to a host can check for and install updates for its own program again; if the host runs another version, the connection screen offers the update
- Technical problems are sent to the developer automatically in the background when there is internet (without asking; each problem once, with no personal data). This can be turned off under Settings > Error reports
- Income and expense can be entered in every currency, the base currency included, in every business sector (the setting for it is gone)
- The company details no longer ask for province / state and district / city
- Opening balances in a currency or metal need their purchase rate (on the screen and in Excel); the rate appears in the rate list, so base currency equivalents are right
- The opening balances screen has a transaction category column, as in the Excel import
- New report: Income statement. Income and expenses by transaction category, monthly, yearly or for a date range, on an accrual or cash basis, by main category or in detail
- New report: Assets and liabilities. Cash and bank, receivables by due date, payables and the net position (equity) on month ends, year ends or two dates, with a net position bridge, the currency and gold position and financial indicators
- New help: every topic is a step-by-step guide in your own language. Choose what you want to do, then follow one step at a time (or all on one page) with a screenshot of the program in your language, numbered marks on what to click, tips, "Stuck?" answers and the meaning of the words. F1 opens the guide of the current screen; the earlier full text stays under "All details and rules"
- The "This database cannot be opened here" screen offers three buttons: load a transfer package, restore from a backup, or set up from scratch. A fresh setup does not delete the old data; it is moved aside into an "old-…" folder. The setup screen shows its other ways as buttons too
